question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

__________ a child, he was tender and warm-hearted.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**as**" is used to indicate the role or capacity of something in a specific state or situation. (जैसे कि)
 
• Example:** As** a teacher, she was very kind to her students.
 
• In the context, **"As** a child, he was tender and warm-hearted" means that during his childhood, he exhibited these qualities.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**As**'.

**Complete Sentence:** ***As** a child, he was tender and warm-hearted.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **So (इसलिए)**: Used to show the result or consequence.

 
 
• **Example: **It was raining, so we stayed indoors.
 
 
 
• **Be (होना)**: Base form of "to be," does not fit grammatically in the blank.
